QUESTION:
What does the `--include-internal` flag of `pq snapshot purge` do?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0708] cli | pq snapshot purge | version 4.x
# `pq snapshot purge`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Purges a snapshot.

## Usage
```
pq snapshot purge <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--since` | Only consider objects created after this timestamp (ISO 8601). |
| `--retain-days` | Number of days the result is kept before it is deleted automatically. |
| `--include-internal` | Also show internal system objects (names starting with `__`). |

## Example
```
pq snapshot purge orders --since
```

---

[d0106] cli | pq snapshot list | version 4.x
# `pq snapshot list`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Lists snapshots.

## Usage
```
pq snapshot list <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--force` | Skip the confirmation prompt. |
| `--timeout` | Seconds to wait for the operation to finish. Default: 30. |
| `--max-parallel` | Maximum number of nodes processed at the same time. Default: 2. |
| `--include-internal` | Also show internal system objects (names starting with `__`). |

## Example
```
pq snapshot list orders --force
```

---

[d0188] cli | pq topic purge | version 4.x
# `pq topic purge`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Purges a topic.

## Usage
```
pq topic purge <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--since` | Only consider objects created after this timestamp (ISO 8601). |
| `--include-internal` | Also show internal system objects (names starting with `__`). |
| `--output` | Output format: `table`, `json` or `yaml`. Default: `table`. |

## Example
```
pq topic purge orders --since
```

[d0915] cli | pq snapshot describe | version 4.x
# `pq snapshot describe`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Describes a snapshot.

## Usage
```
pq snapshot describe <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--since` | Only consider objects created after this timestamp (ISO 8601). |
| `--wait` | Block until the operation is completed on all nodes. |
| `--include-internal` | Also show internal system objects (names starting with `__`). |
| `--tenant` | Name of the tenant the command applies to. |

## Example
```
pq snapshot describe orders --since
```

---

[d0001] cli | pq snapshot pause | version 4.x
# `pq snapshot pause`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Pauses a snapshot.

## Usage
```
pq snapshot pause <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--wait` | Block until the operation is completed on all nodes. |
| `--include-internal` | Also show internal system objects (names starting with `__`). |
| `--force` | Skip the confirmation prompt. |

## Example
```
pq snapshot pause orders --wait
```

response.content: The `--include-internal` flag also shows internal system objects—those whose names start with `__`.
